column1: # Provider specifications served from a URL rather than a git repository.
# A document here has no upstream revision to pin -- Google serves Discovery
# live, and a raw.githubusercontent.com URL tracks a branch -- so the document
# itself is the pin: it is committed under specs/, and a plain `make specs-sync`
# uses the committed copy. SPECS_REFRESH=1 refetches and shows whatever changed
# as a reviewable diff, which is the point: an unannounced vendor change is
# visible exactly because a build never refetches silently.
# A service is fetched only when specs/mirror.set asks for it.
# The path may name a .yaml or .yml document as well as a .json one. YAML and
# JSON are two spellings of one data model, so mirrorgen re-serializes YAML
# before asking which specification a document is -- and hashes the vendor's
# original bytes, never the re-serialization, because those are what the lock
# pins. DigitalOcean publishes only YAML.
# The URL column may instead be the word `authored`, which says this document
# has no upstream: nothing fetches it, SPECS_REFRESH cannot move it, and the
# lock records its source as `authored` rather than a URL. Its sha256 is still
# the pin, so editing it is a visible diff -- what is gone is the ability to
# notice that a VENDOR changed something, because no vendor publishes it.
# That is a real loss and the category is meant to stay almost empty. One entry
# is in it. vercel.kv is the Vercel KV data plane, which is Upstash Redis on a
# Vercel host: Upstash publishes OpenAPI for QStash, for Workflow and for the
# management plane at api.upstash.com/v2, and for the command endpoint nothing;
# Vercel's own document has blob-store management and no KV commands. Both
# describe the data plane in prose only. The alternative was deleting a working
# surface, so the document says in its own description that it is authored, and
# every cell it feeds is `authored` provenance.
# format: <service-id>
cloudflare.api
digitalocean.v2
fly.machines
gcp.storage
hetzner.v1
hostinger.api
vercel.api
vercel.kv
